To extract the ticket information and convert it into a JSON object format, we parse the relevant details from the text provided. Here is the JSON representation of the extracted ticket information:

```json
[
  {
    "Ticket Number": "6LWN00YP",
    "Court": "Chatsworth Courthouse",
    "Law Enforcement Agency": "California Highway Patrol",
    "Violation Date": "4/17/2021",
    "Status": "Closed"
  }
]
```

This JSON object contains a list with one dictionary, as there is only one ticket detailed in the text. Each dictionary includes the ticket number, court, law enforcement agency, violation date, and status of the ticket.
